title: sarcochilus philippinensis
intro: Sarcochilus philippinensis, commonly known as the Philippine orchid, is a type of epiphytic orchid native to the Philippines. This plant is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, cough, and respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Sarcochilus philippinensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, relieve cough, and alleviate fever, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant have been found to include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
